brief:
Hamas confirmed Sunday that a senior commander involved in planning and overseeing the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, according to Reuters. The Israeli military also confirmed his death.

The commander held a key role in Hamas operations and had direct involvement in the October 7 assault that triggered the current conflict in Gaza.
dek: By Nidal al-Mughrabi and Yomna Ehab Nov 15 (Reuters) - Hamas said on Sunday that a senior commander who helped plan and oversee the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, with the Israeli military confirming his death.
title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza
